verification.method: Compare every managed entry to immutable authoritative source trees by Git blob ID, regular-file type, executable mode and size. Hash the six changed files from exact UTF-8 source bytes and independently verify each Git SHA1 blob. Reuse previous SHA256 verification only when the immutable blob/mode/size is unchanged. No newline or content normalization.
verification.hash_implementation: Plain JavaScript SHA256 and SHA1 verified against empty-string, abc, standard multiblock vectors, and Git empty blob. All fetched text independently agrees with GitHub's blob identity.

integration.terminal_resolution: 11 exact new terminal/workflow/evidence blobs applied; eight earlier terminal paths already match. Six incoming managed Office blobs are identical to the current host. Preserve newer Zotero feature sources and manifest/QUDS_FORKS instead of the terminal branch's older Office metadata.
integration.snapshot_boundary: Snapshot above is the final recent-branch boundary for this checkpoint. Feature work remains on the existing draft branch.

validation.limitation: The command execution environment was unavailable. All 39 new cases are committed but unexecuted. Source review and immutable blob/hash comparisons do not establish compilation, runtime behavior, live translator interoperability or native Word/Zotero acceptance.
validation.version_guard_limit: Detects reported changes between responses; does not create a server-side snapshot transaction
